note: An experiment (GAME_SPEC §6 Pistons, §13.7, Stage 79; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 27; asked for by the user, 2026-11-27) on data/benches/charles.json: a sealed syringe of air, its plunger free, stood in ice water and then in hot water: its air contracts and expands, the plunger following. The volume against the temperature is a line, which reaches nothing near -273 C: absolute zero.
title: Experiment: Charles's law and absolute zero

steps.title: Your guess
steps.text: The syringe holds 30 mL of air at 20 C, its plunger free to move. What will it read in ice water at 0 C? Type your guess in mL, then click "predict".
steps.why: Free, the plunger moves until the air inside is at the room's pressure: the air takes as much room as its temperature asks.

steps.title: Into the ice water
steps.text: Pick up the syringe, then right-click the beaker of ice water. In the menu, click "stand it in".
steps.why: The ice water reaches the air through the syringe's glass, all the way up to its plunger.

checks.text: the syringe in the ice water

steps.title: It contracts
steps.text: Watch the plunger as the air cools.
steps.why: Colder air pushes less on the plunger: the room pushes it in, until the air inside is at the room's pressure again, in less room.

steps.title: Record it
steps.text: Right-click the syringe and click "+ T" and "+ mL".

steps.title: Into the hot water
steps.text: Pick up the syringe, then right-click the beaker of hot water, and "stand it in".

checks.text: the syringe in the hot water

steps.title: It expands
steps.text: Watch the plunger rise as the air warms.

checks.text: the air near the hot water's temperature

steps.title: Record it again
steps.text: Record its temperature and its volume. Then, in the notebook, draw the line through the two points: where does it reach no volume at all?
steps.why: Every gas's line, at any pressure, reaches nothing at the same temperature, -273 C: absolute zero, the coldest anything can be (Kelvin's scale starts there). No gas gets there: it turns liquid first.

goal.text: every element, mass and energy unchanged

report.label: the volume at 0 C
report.why: 30 mL x 273 K / 293 K is 27.95 mL; the plunger stops a little short, held by its friction.

report.label: absolute zero, from your line
report.why: The line through the two readings, run back to no volume. The model's: about -276 C, the plunger's friction holding each reading a little short of the bath's own.
